summary: Lane chars passes round 1. Its one package item, chars-r2-01 (minor, W4 re-key handoff), was re-measured in the current tree and it is done. Ervet's Whole Again form now shows the whole blade at its usual size with glowing shard seams. Measured from the committed GLB (bind pose, through the skin matrices): form_great has exactly the same vertex positions as form_base (max difference 0.0 m). It is 1.314 x 0.154 x 0.028 m, where the old form_great reached x 1.051 m against the base blade's 0.696 m. The seams are a separate accent node, form_great_1 (136 tris, 164 verts, bound to prop.R), with 68 seam faces on each face of the blade. 0 of its 164 vertices are below the glass: vertices sit 1.43-5.40 mm above it and face centres 0.87-1.78 mm. The live renderer (render bench, real catalog) reads form_great_1 as form 'great': its node shows only in that form and is hidden in base and hilt. It takes the per-actor accent clone and the team tint (menu showcase shots). check_glb shows 0 errors on all 3 GLBs. three_snapshot reproduces the claimed numbers exactly (great accent 2.25 % / top half 53.5 %; lamplit 2.21 %; stillwater 2.22 %; bind box X 1.39 m against the old 1.745 m). The face-locked LOD1 still holds (5,814 of 5,814 head triangles kept, 0 mismatches), and typecheck exits 0. The head close-ups of the base and both skins show the same slit-and-star visor as the reviewed base. The skins' face geometry is identical to the base's: the accent mesh differs by 0.0 m and the head-region vertices by 0.0 m. Nothing reads as horror, hockey mask, beak or mannequin, and there is no hood. Base-form heads before and after the rebuild are visually identical. Minor observations, none blocking: (1) the dev-server catalog dist-catalog (git-ignored) was republished at 04:20:36, before the lamplit rebuild finished. :5190 still serves the old 62ccfe4b2569-ervet_lamplit.glb (1,009,596 B), so in the live menu the Lamplit great form still shows the old oversized blade. The committed art/out file is correct, and the next `npm run content` fixes it. (2) The engine-owned Whole Again VFX still draws a 3.4-3.5 m 'oversized blade' ghost (content/vfx.json ervet_ult_shards_home / ervet_ult_whole, shape 'blade', scale up to 3.5, and their $comment says 'the oversized blade'). The engineer returned no handoff for it. (3) Seams are rarely visible during the run cycle, because the run pose carries the blade up and behind her; they read in the idle, lobby and attack poses. The stitch item chars-lod-support was not claimed and was not verified. Process note: running `art/build.py check` rewrote the tracked file art/out/manifest.json at 04:37. The wip-sync log shows the tree was clean at 04:27, and I wrote the committed HEAD content back, so the file is unmodified again.

That is a 3.4-3.5 m glowing blade ghost against Ervet's 1.31 m blade. Their $comments say 'the oversized blade condenses whole' and 'the oversized blade slams down whole'. The W4 re-key (W4_systems_rekey.md row 77) cut the oversized reforged blade (reach stays 2.0 m). The chars engineer returned no handoff for this. content/vfx.json is engine-owned, so it is outside lane chars.
items.fixHint: Handoff to lane engine (content/vfx.json): in ervet_ult_shards_home and ervet_ult_whole, scale the 'blade' mesh layer to Ervet's real blade (about 1.3 m: scale about 1.3, and a stretch that keeps it about 0.15 m wide), or replace it with a seam flash along the existing blade at socket 'weapon'/'blade_tip'.
